name: NCX emulated open-box controls
scope: Existing native scripted input semantics emulated only by explicit Prime harness modes; ordinary supported solid box geometry, no invisible/beam-transparent brushes

roles.0: Samus participant: both source and victim
roles.1: Samus participant: both source and victim
roles.2: Optional connected Samus observer: no fire, real native camera

controls.ammunition: Existing harness native ammo cap refill
controls.tap: stock ShotCooldown*2+3 frames; held first3 while aim error<2.5 degrees
controls.aim: native convergence helper, +/-6 degrees per frame, y+.95 for300 frames then y+.30 for300
controls.placement: slot0 x=-6 and slot1 x=6; if |x-cellX|>2 place own harness actor at(cellX,.6,0); record placements
controls.lateral: MoveLeft/MoveRight alternate every40 local simulation frames
controls.jump: No Jump input; normal declared vertical pads own motion
controls.observer: No controls; if alive and |x|>1 or |z-9|>1, scripted placement(0,.6,9); no camera relocation
controls.deadParticipant: Native Shoot input requests respawn, aiming down6 degrees per frame; incidental respawn shots remain measured

limits: Not a legal-hit oracle or pixel certification
Native observed motion, placements, rates and role assignment must be measured
Both participants fire; generic Prime powerbeam Volley with one shooter is a different workload
Observer keeps actual native camera and may lack a visible shot; no invented visibility
No native presentation-hz equivalent is qualified
